# Chronosphere Documentation

> Documentation for the Chronosphere Observability Platform and Telemetry Pipeline: ingesting metrics, logs, traces, and change events; building dashboards and notebooks; alerting, SLOs, and incident response; controlling data volume and cost; and administering accounts, tools, and the Config, Data, and State APIs.

## Docs
- [Chronosphere documentation](https://docs.chronosphere.io/index.md): Learn about the aspects of the Chronosphere documentation.

## Observability Platform

### Overview
- [Chronosphere Observability Platform](https://docs.chronosphere.io/overview.md): Learn about the Chronosphere Observability Platform and its capabilities.
- [Get started with Observability Platform](https://docs.chronosphere.io/overview/get-started.md): Learn about several of the common paths to complete tasks in Chronosphere Observability Platform.

### Concepts
- [Observability Platform concepts](https://docs.chronosphere.io/overview/concepts.md): Learn more about components, concepts, and terms used by Chronosphere Observability Platform.
- [Change events](https://docs.chronosphere.io/overview/concepts/change-events.md): Learn about how to use change events to understand what changed in your environment.
- [Time units](https://docs.chronosphere.io/overview/concepts/time-units.md): Standard time units used by Chronosphere Observability Platform
- [Metrics dictionary](https://docs.chronosphere.io/overview/concepts/dictionary.md): Use the metrics dictionary to learn about metrics created by and specific to Chronosphere Observability Platform.
- [Distributed tracing](https://docs.chronosphere.io/overview/concepts/distributed-tracing.md): Learn about distributed tracing in Chronosphere Observability Platform.

### Data types
- [Data types](https://docs.chronosphere.io/overview/types.md): Learn how to explore telemetry data in Observability Platform.
- [Ingest, query, and control your metric data](https://docs.chronosphere.io/overview/types/metrics.md): Learn about how Observability Platform can help you understand what's driving data storage volume and use.
- [Ingest, query, and control your log data](https://docs.chronosphere.io/overview/types/logs.md): Learn about how to get started with Chronosphere Observability Platform logging.
- [Ingest, query, and control your trace data](https://docs.chronosphere.io/overview/types/traces.md): Learn about interacting with trace data in Chronosphere Observability Platform.
- [Ingest, filter, and overlay change events](https://docs.chronosphere.io/overview/types/change-events.md): Learn about interacting with change events in Chronosphere Observability Platform.

### Overview
- [Authenticate with Observability Platform as a user](https://docs.chronosphere.io/overview/authenticating.md): Authenticate with Chronosphere Observability Platform by signing in with single sign-on, a password, or a personal access token.

### Case studies
- [Case studies](https://docs.chronosphere.io/overview/case-studies/case-studies.md): End-to-end workflow case studies demonstrating how teams use Chronosphere Observability Platform to solve real-world problems.
- [Case study: responding to incidents](https://docs.chronosphere.io/overview/case-studies/respond-to-incidents.md): A narrative walkthrough of an on-call engineer investigating and resolving a production incident using Chronosphere Observability Platform.
- [Case study: protecting a telemetry data budget](https://docs.chronosphere.io/overview/case-studies/manage-budgets.md): A narrative walkthrough of an administrator investigating a telemetry data spike, repartitioning consumption, and revising budgets in Chronosphere Observability Platform.

### Guides
- [Observability Platform guides](https://docs.chronosphere.io/overview/guides.md): Learn about common workflows in Chronosphere Observability Platform.
- [Respond to incidents](https://docs.chronosphere.io/overview/guides/incident-response.md): A workflow guide for on-call engineers who receive, triage, investigate, and resolve alerts in Chronosphere Observability Platform.
- [Manage telemetry data budgets](https://docs.chronosphere.io/overview/guides/manage-budgets.md): A workflow guide for administrators who partition telemetry data, analyze consumption, and set budget thresholds in Chronosphere Observability Platform.

### Navigate
- [Navigate the Observability Platform interface](https://docs.chronosphere.io/navigate.md): Learn how to navigate the Chronosphere Observability Platform to find the functions you need to gain insight into your platforms.

### Assistant
- [Ask the Assistant about your telemetry](https://docs.chronosphere.io/navigate/assistant.md): Learn how the Assistant answers questions, queries telemetry, and edits dashboards in Observability Platform.
- [Assistant interface reference](https://docs.chronosphere.io/navigate/assistant/interface.md): Reference for the controls, message elements, and keyboard shortcuts in the Chronosphere Assistant.
- [Assistant capabilities reference](https://docs.chronosphere.io/navigate/assistant/capabilities.md): Reference for the data the Chronosphere Assistant reads, the skills it uses, and the changes it can make.

### Navigate
- [Search for resources in Observability Platform](https://docs.chronosphere.io/navigate/search.md): Use global search to find dashboards, monitors, services, SLOs, teams, and collections by name, and open the Assistant when you want to describe what you're looking for.
- [Use notebooks to gather related information](https://docs.chronosphere.io/navigate/notebooks.md): Use notebooks to gather graphs, charts, and other resources from multiple pages into one place while troubleshooting a problem.
- [Filter across pages using pinned scopes](https://docs.chronosphere.io/navigate/pinned-scopes.md): Learn about Chronosphere Observability Platform cross-page filtering.
- [Select time ranges](https://docs.chronosphere.io/navigate/time-ranges.md): Use the time range selector to scope queries, charts, tables, and graphs across monitors, dashboards, service pages, and explorers.
- [Use comments to provide context](https://docs.chronosphere.io/navigate/comments.md): Learn about how to use comments in Chronosphere Observability Platform to identify important data.
- [Create favorites to find resources quickly](https://docs.chronosphere.io/navigate/favorites.md): Mark dashboards and monitors as favorites to reach them faster from your personal home page, filtered resource lists, and search results.

### Analyze data
- [Analyze live traffic metrics](https://docs.chronosphere.io/investigate/analyze/telemetry-analyzer.md): Use Live Telemetry Analyzer to view incoming metrics, troubleshoot ingest spikes, and identify metrics to reduce.

- [Analyze query load](https://docs.chronosphere.io/investigate/analyze/query-analyzer.md): Use Query Analyzer to rank monitor and recording rule queries by relative load and assess which to modify.

### Configure alerts

### Monitors

- [Use annotations with monitors](https://docs.chronosphere.io/investigate/alerts/monitors/monitor-annotations.md): Add text annotations and template variables to monitors so notifications and detail pages give on-call engineers context.
- [Add templated links to monitors](https://docs.chronosphere.io/investigate/alerts/monitors/annotation-links.md): Configure dashboard and log links on monitors so responders open investigation context scoped to each alert signal.
- [Customize monitor notification messages](https://docs.chronosphere.io/investigate/alerts/monitors/notification-templates.md): Use notification templates to control the title and description of notifications generated by a monitor.
- [Monitor data model](https://docs.chronosphere.io/investigate/alerts/monitors/data-model.md): Understand the YAML data model for monitors, including how teams, collections, monitors, and notification policies relate.

### Shape and sample
- [Shape and sample your data](https://docs.chronosphere.io/control/shaping.md): Learn how to use shaping rules to take control of your telemetry data.

### Shape metrics
- [Shape metric data](https://docs.chronosphere.io/control/shaping/shape-metrics.md): Learn how metric shaping rules and downsampling control cardinality, license consumption, and query performance.
- [Metric types](https://docs.chronosphere.io/control/shaping/shape-metrics/types.md): Learn how counters, gauges, histograms, and other metric types affect aggregation, long-term downsampling, and query results.

### Shaping rules
- [Metric shaping rules](https://docs.chronosphere.io/control/shaping/shape-metrics/rules.md): Learn about the ways to use rules in Chronosphere Observability Platform to shape metric data.
- [Rollup rules](https://docs.chronosphere.io/control/shaping/shape-metrics/rules/rollup.md): What are rollup rules, and how to create, edit, or delete them.
- [Recording rules](https://docs.chronosphere.io/control/shaping/shape-metrics/rules/recording.md): Learn about recording rules and when to use them, along with their limitations.
- [Mapping rules](https://docs.chronosphere.io/control/shaping/shape-metrics/rules/mapping.md): Learn about how and when to use mapping rules before storing any results in the database.
- [Drop rules](https://docs.chronosphere.io/control/shaping/shape-metrics/rules/drop-rules.md): Use drop rules to omit metrics you don't need and persist only the metrics that matter.
- [Find and fix rule and monitor evaluation failures](https://docs.chronosphere.io/control/shaping/shape-metrics/rules/evaluation-failures.md): View and fix recording rule and monitor evaluation failures.

### Reduce cardinality
- [Reduce cardinality](https://docs.chronosphere.io/control/shaping/shape-metrics/reduce-cardinality.md): Learn how to use the tools provided by Chronosphere Observability Platform to identify and reduce metric cardinality.
- [Review aggregation rules](https://docs.chronosphere.io/control/shaping/shape-metrics/reduce-cardinality/aggregation-rules.md): Use the Aggregation Rules page to review your aggregation rules.
- [Preview aggregation rule impact](https://docs.chronosphere.io/control/shaping/shape-metrics/reduce-cardinality/shaping-impact.md): Use the Shaping Impact Preview to preview the impact of aggregation rules on your system before applying them.
- [Apply rule recommendations](https://docs.chronosphere.io/control/shaping/shape-metrics/reduce-cardinality/recommendations.md): Use the Recommendations page to identify and reduce metrics and labels with no usage or utility over the past 30 days.

### Quotas and pools
- [Understand metric quotas and pools](https://docs.chronosphere.io/control/shaping/shape-metrics/quotas.md): Learn about metric quotas and pools, and how to give each pool a specific quota of your total persisted writes license.
- [Define a metric pool](https://docs.chronosphere.io/control/shaping/shape-metrics/quotas/define-pools.md): Learn about metric pool concepts and how to apply them to help shape defining a metric pool.
- [View allocated pools](https://docs.chronosphere.io/control/shaping/shape-metrics/quotas/quotas-ui.md): View the persisted writes quota allocated to and consumed by each metrics pool to find pools at risk of being limited.
- [Manage metric pools](https://docs.chronosphere.io/control/shaping/shape-metrics/quotas/manage-pools.md): Add, edit, and preview metric pool quota allocations on the Metrics Quotas page in Chronosphere Observability Platform.

### Shape metrics

- [Use trace behaviors with datasets](https://docs.chronosphere.io/control/shaping/sample-traces/behaviors.md): Use behaviors in Chronosphere Observability Platform to set sampling rules for your trace datasets without writing fine-grained sampling rules.
- [Head sampling](https://docs.chronosphere.io/control/shaping/sample-traces/head-sampling.md): Learn how to configure head sampling to capture a portion of your traces from originating services.
- [Tail sampling](https://docs.chronosphere.io/control/shaping/sample-traces/tail-sampling.md): Learn about how to configure tail sampling to configure filters on trace data before it's stored.

### Install
- [Install the Chronosphere Collector](https://docs.chronosphere.io/ingest/metrics-traces/collector/install.md): Compare Chronosphere Collector installation methods for collecting metrics with Kubernetes or a standalone binary and for receiving traces.
- [Kubernetes Collector installation to retrieve metrics](https://docs.chronosphere.io/ingest/metrics-traces/collector/install/kubernetes.md): Install the Chronosphere Collector as a Kubernetes DaemonSet, Deployment, or sidecar to scrape Prometheus metrics from your cluster.
- [Kubernetes Collector installation to receive traces](https://docs.chronosphere.io/ingest/metrics-traces/collector/install/tracing.md): Install the Chronosphere Collector as a Kubernetes Deployment to receive OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, or Zipkin trace data from your apps.
- [Standalone Collector installation to retrieve metrics](https://docs.chronosphere.io/ingest/metrics-traces/collector/install/standalone.md): Run the Chronosphere Collector as a standalone binary to gather metrics from services that Kubernetes doesn't manage.
- [Upgrade the Collector](https://docs.chronosphere.io/ingest/metrics-traces/collector/install/upgrade.md): Upgrade the Chronosphere Collector to a new version.

- [Ingest log data](https://docs.chronosphere.io/ingest/logs.md): Learn about how to ingest log data into Observability Platform.
- [Route logs from Fluent Bit](https://docs.chronosphere.io/ingest/logs/fluentbit-logs.md): Learn how to route logs from Fluent Bit to Chronosphere Observability Platform.
- [Route logs from Google Cloud Platform](https://docs.chronosphere.io/ingest/logs/gcp-logs.md): Learn how to route logs from Google Cloud Platform into Chronosphere Observability Platform.
- [Route logs over HTTP](https://docs.chronosphere.io/ingest/logs/http-logs.md): Use the Chronosphere logging HTTP endpoint to send logs to your Observability Platform tenant over HTTP.
- [Route logs from Logstash](https://docs.chronosphere.io/ingest/logs/logstash-logs.md): Learn how to route logs from Logstash to Chronosphere Observability Platform.
- [Use OpenTelemetry protocol endpoints](https://docs.chronosphere.io/ingest/logs/otel-logs.md): Learn how to configure and use Chronosphere Observability Platform endpoints for OpenTelemetry protocol ingestion of log data.
- [Route logs through Telemetry Pipeline](https://docs.chronosphere.io/ingest/logs/pipeline-logs.md): Learn how to route log data through Chronosphere Telemetry Pipeline to Chronosphere Observability Platform.
